description:
Kesh will see you now.

It is a consultation, and it is genuinely one. She will talk you out of two of the three things you might have wanted, on the grounds that they are not worth what they cost you. She is a good surgeon and she is not selling.

What she does not say, because it is on the form and she assumes you have read the form, is that this is the last appointment at which you are a person who has never been opened. The Exodus can undo it, at a price, and nobody else in this city can, and Kesh does not do that work and will not say who does.

"Sit down," she says. "Nothing today. Today we talk about it, and you go home, and you think about whether you want it. Come back when you know."
name: The Account

emotes: {who} is talked out of the expensive one, at length, by the woman who would have been paid for it.
{who} is asked what they do with their hands all day, and answers, and watches her write it down.
{who} signs the form on the second page and is not asked to read the first.
